note: Anime Type Quiz（ガチアニメ診断）の英語。axes の name・desc と nick（二つ名の部品）は、診断本体の英語の文字列（shindananime の src/strings.js の en）と同じ。ask と body は /en/anime/axes/ の解説文で、日本語（data/anime-axes.json）から訳した。

axes.label: World
axes.ask: Is the setting an extension of reality, or another world?
axes.body: Whether the story’s world continues from the lives we live now, or runs on entirely different rules. People who lean R (Realistic) are moved by grounded settings such as school, work and family. People who lean F (Fantasy) get drawn in most by settings that let them forget reality for a while: magic, other worlds, invented civilizations. Neither side is better.

pos.name: Realistic
pos.desc: You are moved by grounded human drama

neg.name: Fantasy
neg.desc: You get fired up by a world far from reality

axes.label: Aftertaste
axes.ask: After it ends, do you want weight or a lift?
axes.body: An axis about how stories end and how intense they get on the way. D (Dark) people can savor merciless turns and a heavy afterglow as part of the work. H (Happy) people want things to pay off in the end, however hard the middle gets. The quiz asks about genre likes such as gore or romance separately; this axis looks at your taste in aftertaste itself.

pos.name: Dark
pos.desc: You remember stories most when there is no salvation

neg.name: Happy
neg.desc: You want reversals and a happy finale

axes.label: Structure & pace
axes.ask: Do you want to pick up foreshadowing, or ride the momentum?
axes.body: Your taste in how a story is built. C (Foreshadowing) puts weight on small oddities early on that pay off later, and on the fun of solving a setting’s mysteries. S (Pace & momentum) wants to be pulled along by fast developments and episode-by-episode highs rather than fine logic. The difference is whether you watch while thinking ahead, or ride the moment.

pos.name: Foreshadowing
pos.desc: You love picking up foreshadowing and theorizing

neg.name: Pace & momentum
neg.desc: You want to be swept along by momentum and tempo

axes.label: Sub-taste
axes.ask: Is the highlight a battle of wits, or action?
axes.body: Your taste in what kind of highlight you want. P (Mind games) enjoys reading what lies beneath words and the maneuvering between characters. A (Action) gets fired up by animation showpieces and powerful fights. In the type code, one letter is given depending on which side your answers lean to on average.

pos.name: Mind games
pos.desc: You like mind games and drama between the lines

neg.name: Action
neg.desc: You like animation showpieces and powerful battles

axes.label: Visual vs story
axes.ask: What decides it for you: the visuals or the script?
axes.body: An axis about what draws you to a work. V (Visuals) people come in through color, composition and a sense of direction. T (Story) people will follow a show with plain art if the script is good. The quiz asks about picture quality and era as a separate item, and that is not part of the type code.

pos.name: Visuals
pos.desc: You get hooked by visuals and directing

neg.name: Story
neg.desc: You choose by script and story

axes.label: Viewing style
axes.ask: Do you savor it slowly, or enjoy it casually?
axes.body: An axis about viewing habits. M (Deep-dive) people savor one episode at a time and read reactions and analyses afterward. L (Binge) people watch something fun all at once and move on to the next show. It looks at how you watch, not at how heavy the work is.

pos.name: Deep-dive
pos.desc: You savor one episode at a time, then read every analysis

neg.name: Binge
neg.desc: You binge what is fun, then move on to the next
